thread:
Sam (CS): Morning team  kicking off HarborHouse onboarding. Short sync: owners, measurable success criteria, 30/60/90 milestones.
Renee (HarborHouse): Hi all  Renee here. I'll own internal rollout and approvals.
Sam (CS): Proposed owners:
- Sam (CS): program lead, enablement, feedback capture
- Ivy (Solutions): integration, test harness, infra templates
- Dante (PM): acceptance tests + post-rollout QA
- Renee (HarborHouse): business owner, taxonomy + stakeholders
Ivy (Solutions): Good. I can deliver a smoke harness and sample ingestion script in 8 business days.
Dante (PM): Acceptance criteria draft:
1) p95 latency < 600ms for search-classify flows on Dedicated
2) Classification top-1 >= 87% on their taxonomy eval
3) Two engineers can run E2E demo by day 14
4) Pilot to 5 stores with zero P1s during pilot window
Renee (HarborHouse): We'll provide a 300-row sanitized dataset by Wednesday. Legal will confirm PII clearance.
Sam (CS): Noted. Risk items to track: procurement cost target <$0.0045/unit, legal/PII, need for fine-tune.
Ivy (Solutions): Quick repo snippet for their engineers:
```
# Redwood quickstart sample
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=REDACTED
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-medium-v2","prompt":"classify: <product_text>"}'
```
Dante (PM): Suggest adding nightly eval job to catch regressions and a cost dashboard in Redwood Console.
Sam (CS): Agreed. I'll own the dashboard wiring and weekly 30-min sync cadence. Recommend workshop week 2 for hands-on.
Renee (HarborHouse): Week 2 workshop OK. Please send agenda.
calendar-bot: Invite created: "HarborHouse  Redwood Onboarding Workshop" Tue 10:00 PT  attendees: Sam, Ivy, Dante, Renee
Sam (CS): Next steps: 1) Renee uploads sanitized CSV (Wed) 2) Ivy runs smoke harness (8 bd) 3) Sam schedules workshop + posts acceptance checklist 4) Dante readies eval alerts.
Renee (HarborHouse): Uploading samples later today. Thanks  excited to get started.
Sam (CS): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll post the onboarding checklist link after this thread.
